title: RM9.5mil channelled to 150 cooperatives affected by pandemic | The Star
text:
RM9.5mil channelled to 150 cooperatives affected by pandemic | The Star
KUALA NERUS: An allocation of RM9.5mil has been channeled to 150 cooperatives affected by Covid-19 this year.
Entrepreneur Development and Cooperatives Minister Tan Sri Noh Omar ( pic ) said the assistance was channelled through the Cooperative Movement Economic Transformation (Transfer) programme to help increase the activities of the institutions during post Covid-19 period.
